description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named LeaveBalanceWithLeavePeriod, which encapsulates a LeaveBalance object and optionally a LeavePeriod object. It provides getter and setter methods for these properties, facilitating the passing of leave balance information along with a specific leave period within the HRM system.

classes.name: LeaveBalanceWithLeavePeriod
classes.description: A DTO class that holds a leave balance and an optional leave period.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize leaveBalance and optionally leavePeriod.
